_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Statistically honest coil default: no funding-plus-momentum breaker to Optimism and no fear_greed/CVD break to Disbelief, so Hope holds.
next_move.brains_agree: partial — analyst clear HOLD/Hope; narrative silent on forward phase but BTC/metals softness does not contradict the coil
next_move.confirmed_if: Funding stays near flat, fear_greed roughly 55-70, 30d momentum still sub-70
next_move.invalidated_if: Funding and 30d momentum re-accelerate together toward mid-70s (up into Optimism) or spot CVD and price roll with fear_greed under 50 (down into Disbelief)
